stories.title: Asian stocks turn cautious as oil rises and bond yields climb
stories.summary: Asian equity markets traded cautiously as oil prices rose and bond yields climbed. The two moves together added pressure on risk assets across the region. Traders watched to see whether the caution would spread to other markets.
stories.whyItMatters: Rising oil prices and bond yields together can squeeze equity valuations and raise borrowing costs across markets.
whatToWatch: Whether oil prices keep rising
The direction of bond yields in coming sessions

stories.title: AI companies' heavy debt loads face new risk as bond yields spike
stories.summary: CNBC reports that AI companies carrying significant debt face increased risk as bond yields spike. Higher yields raise the cost of servicing and refinancing that debt. The report flags this as a growing concern for the sector's financing model.
stories.whyItMatters: Much of the AI buildout depends on cheap financing, so higher yields could slow the capital-intensive expansion driving the sector's growth.

stories.title: BOJ minutes show debate over faster rate hikes at July meeting
stories.summary: Minutes from the Bank of Japan's July meeting show policymakers debated whether to raise interest rates faster, Investing.com reports. Some members reportedly see a case for a quicker pace of tightening. The minutes give a rare look at the central bank's internal debate.
stories.whyItMatters: A shift toward faster BOJ tightening would affect the yen, Japanese bond yields, and global carry trades tied to Japan's low rates.

stories.title: Dollar firms as US-Iran tensions lift oil and hawkish Fed bets build

stories.whyItMatters: Rising oil prices combined with hawkish Fed bets can pressure risk assets while adding to inflation and rate concerns across markets.
